newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol to make pilot TV lottery show for BBC.
newsitem.headline: Endemol to make pilot TV lottery show for BBC.

text.p: Dutch television production company Endemol Entertainment NV said on Wednesday the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) had asked Endemol to produce a pilot programme for a regular television lottery show.
Endemol said the show, to be produced in association with Britain's National Lottery, would have 300,000 sterling in prize money and would probably be called Dream Ticket.
On the basis of the pilot programme the BBC would decide this summer whether the show would be broadcast during the coming winter season, Endemol said.

Endemol, chiefly known for its game shows and other light entertainment programmes, already produces similar lottery shows for the Dutch and German markets under the titles of Staatsloterijshow and 100.000 DM Show.
